categories.main_business_segments: Reyon Pharmaceutical primarily operates in the pharmaceutical industry focusing on manufacturing and sales of prescription drugs, original drugs (notably CT contrast agents), and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The company also engages in contract manufacturing (CMO) for biopharmaceuticals and chemical drugs, and has expanded into new business areas including genetic engineering drugs, natural medicine production, and animal pharmaceuticals. Additionally, it operates a subsidiary focused on new technology business financing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced synthesis and fermentation technologies for producing APIs such as tacrolimus and arbekacin sulfate. It has established a KGMP-certified bio-factory capable of producing plasmid DNA, viral and non-viral vectors, and mRNA-based materials from raw materials to finished products. Reyon also employs genetic engineering, recombinant DNA technology, and cell culture techniques for biopharmaceutical development, supported by proprietary drug delivery systems and electroporation injector devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Reyon serves hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, pharmaceutical companies, and wholesalers primarily within South Korea. It also exports APIs and finished products to emerging pharmaceutical markets such as India and China, with exclusive supply contracts in place. The company targets therapeutic areas including cardiovascular, antibiotics, ophthalmology, anti-inflammatory, digestive, and oncology, addressing both domestic and global markets through direct and indirect sales channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Jincheon and Chungju. It exports products to international markets including India, China, the United States, Canada, and other global regions. Strategic partnerships and licensing agreements extend its reach worldwide, particularly in Asia and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Reyon operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on manufacturing APIs and finished pharmaceutical products. It also functions as a contract manufacturing organization (CMO), providing production services for biopharmaceuticals and chemical drugs, thereby integrating R&D, production, and commercialization stages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in biopharmaceuticals and chemical drugs, focusing on genetic engineering medicines, natural products, antibody therapeutics, gene therapies, and cell therapies. It pursues open innovation with biotech startups and technology leaders to expand its drug pipeline. Investment in production platform capabilities, including the KGMP-certified Chungju bio-factory, supports integrated development and manufacturing. Reyon also invests in novel drug delivery technologies and electroporation devices to enhance therapeutic efficacy.
categories.revenue_model: Reyon generates revenue through direct sales of prescription pharmaceuticals, original diagnostic agents, and APIs. It also earns income from contract manufacturing services (CMO) for biopharmaceuticals and chemical drugs. Licensing and milestone payments from joint development and technology transfer agreements contribute to revenue, alongside export sales and indirect distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Reyon is positioned as a mid-sized pharmaceutical company in South Korea with a diversified portfolio including high-value APIs and biopharmaceuticals. It competes with domestic firms such as Hanmi Pharmaceutical, Yuhan Corporation, and Daewoong Pharmaceutical, as well as global biotech companies. Its competitive advantages include proprietary high-barrier APIs, exclusive supply contracts in emerging markets, and a growing pipeline of innovative biopharmaceuticals developed through strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Reyon reported consolidated total assets of approximately 499.8 billion KRW and annual sales of 151.1 billion KRW, with operating income of 4 billion KRW and net income of 3.6 billion KRW. The company experienced a slight sales decline compared to the previous year but continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures around 8.6 billion KRW (5.7% of sales). It maintains stable financial health despite short-term liquidity challenges due to convertible bonds, supported by ongoing operational cash flows.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Reyon offers a balanced product portfolio combining stable prescription drugs, exclusive original diagnostic agents, and high-value APIs with significant technical barriers. Its production platform integrates cutting-edge biopharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities, enabling efficient development and commercialization of novel therapies. The company’s open innovation model and strategic partnerships accelerate pipeline expansion while reducing R&D risks and costs. Its proprietary technologies and exclusive supply agreements in key emerging markets provide competitive differentiation and sustainable revenue streams.
